- Time: \(O(N\,k)\)
- Memory: \(O(N)\)

N is the number of pixels per channel and k is the window width. The sliding histogram method of Huang, Yang and Tang updates one column of k values per step. Sorting every window would cost O(N\,k^2 \log k).
